Record Class StaticCompilationPlan

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.StaticCompilationPlan
Record Components:
decisions - The decisions, in source order
bodies - The compiled bodies by Ir.CompiledBody.key()
diagnostics - The warnings (errors in strict mode) for explicit switches that are not honoured
trace - Whether the compiled bodies count their entries
public record StaticCompilationPlan(List<StaticCompilationDecision> decisions, Map<String, Ir.CompiledBody> bodies, List<PythonDiagnostic> diagnostics, boolean trace) extends Record
What the planner decided for a compilation: one decision per function, the bodies it lowered, and the diagnostics for the explicit switches it could not honour.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

    • switchedOn

      public boolean switchedOn(@Nullable String sourcePath, String qualifiedName)
      Whether a function is switched on for static compilation: the planner decided it and did not exclude it. The mode alone does not say it, since a function no CompileStatic switches on is excluded in modes off and annotated, and a switch can exclude a scope in mode all.
      Parameters:
      sourcePath - The path of the source declaring the function, or null to match any source
      qualifiedName - The name of the function as its decision spells it: Class.method
      Returns:
      Whether the function is switched on

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
